description: This source file defines a utility function called shapeStackedSeries, which processes raw cost data records and transforms them into a format suitable for rendering stacked series charts in Recharts. It aggregates costs by service and category (or environment), filling in missing data points with zeros to enable proper visualization.

methods.name: shapeStackedSeries(records, stackBy = "environment", options)
methods.description: Transforms an array of cost records into a dataset suitable for stacked series charts, grouping by specified categories or environment, with optional sorting and labeling.
